mapper.insert: insert ignore into coop_settlement_detail (settlement_id, claim_id, registration_id, origin_amount, create_time) values (#{settlementId}, #{claimId}, #{registrationId}, #{originAmount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, settlement_id, claim_id, registration_id, origin_amount, create_time from coop_settlement_detail where claim_id = #{claimId} for update
